payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about the extraction of textual patterns used for error generation in language processing.

claims.text: Textual patterns are extracted in the form of (incorrect phrase, correct phrase) from an annotated corpus of corrections.
Patterns are learned from the alignment of original and corrected sentences, capturing changes in word forms and using POS tags for matching.
The method allows for generating all types of errors by relaxing previous restrictions on error types.
Patterns are used to insert errors into grammatically correct sentences, enhancing training data for error detection.
